title: It Takes Two
description: Two people, one extraordinary world. Play as Cody and May, a couple transformed into dolls, on a wonderfully unpredictable journey built entirely for two.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
description: Become V, a mercenary searching for a one-of-a-kind implant in Night City. A story about identity, impossible choices, and the people you find at the edge of the future.

title: Elden Ring
description: Rise, Tarnished, and follow the grace of gold into the Lands Between. A vast, mysterious world where every ruin has a story and every distant light is an invitation.

title: Disco Elysium
description: You are a detective with a city to unravel and a mind that will not stay quiet. Question the world, question yourself, and find something worth holding on to in Revachol.

title: Baldur’s Gate 3
description: Gather your party and return to the Forgotten Realms. An adventure shaped by friendship, freedom, and the choices that make a story yours.

title: Outer Wilds
description: An open-world mystery about a solar system trapped in an endless time loop. Pack your curiosity, follow an unfamiliar signal, and discover what waits beyond the next horizon.

title: The Exit 8
description: You are trapped in an endless underground passageway. Observe your surroundings carefully. If you find an anomaly, turn back. Find the way to Exit 8.

title: Dune: Part Two
description: Paul Atreides joins Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. In the desert, a personal journey becomes something much larger.

title: Blade Runner 2049
description: A new blade runner uncovers a secret that could change what remains of society. His search leads through a rain-soaked future, toward questions about memory and being human.

title: Arrival
description: When mysterious spacecraft appear across the world, a linguist searches for a way to communicate. A quiet, moving story about language, time, and the connections that shape a life.

title: Severance
description: A team of office workers have surgically divided their memories between work and personal life. When the boundary begins to unravel, they discover that nothing about their work is ordinary.

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
description: A street kid tries to survive in a city obsessed with technology and body modification. A standalone story in the world of Cyberpunk 2077, about found family and the price of a dream.
